Type: desk
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Curved Wood Table Home Office Computer Desk, 48.4"L, Walnut
Colors: Brown
Materials: Wood
48.4"W x 22.2"D x 31.1"H Walnut veneer finish Simple, practical style with one-drawer storage A classic mid-century design, this desk features iconic clean lines and curves along the back edges for a style that blends with modern or contemporary décor. It features an open work area with a middle drawer underneath for storage. Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
